title: Gallery Stratford

services.name: Go to Exhibitions
services.desc: Selections from this recently discovered archive of nearly 2,500 glass plate negatives produced in France (c.1870s to 1915) are on view for the first time - ever! Marked by damage, and material change, these images are shaped as much by their survival as by the lives and places they depict. “Made in France” signifies more than the place of manufacture; it evokes centuries of fashion innovation, luxury, and influence. This exhibition features selections from the museum’s collection of French garments spanning the late 19th to late 20th century. HOMAGE: Inspired by Outstanding Canadian Women - Donald A Stuart, CM, OOnt, RCA, MFA, AOCA Discover the histories of extraordinary Canadian women

blurb: Gallery Stratford is a non-profit, charitable contemporary, public art gallery featuring changing exhibitions of Canadian art and an adjacent small sculpture park. We are housed within the historic Waterworks Building built 1882-83 and located on the beautiful park system that runs through the heart of the city.
